# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/string_functions#substr
# BigQuery: positions beyond the end return an empty string;
# lengths beyond the end take the rest; negative lengths fail unless an argument is NULL.
# GoogleSQL's GetFunctionTestsSubstr also covers these INT64 and NULL boundaries.

SELECT SUBSTR(s, p) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) p
=> ""

SELECT SUBSTRING(s, p, n) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) p CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> ""

SELECT SUBSTR(s, p, n) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([2]) p CROSS JOIN UNNEST([9223372036854775807]) n
=> "あ😀"

SELECT SUBSTRING(s, p, n) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-9223372036854775808]) p CROSS JOIN UNNEST([2]) n
=> "aあ"

SELECT SUBSTR(s, p, n) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([1]) p CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-1]) n
=> null

SELECT SUBSTRING(s, p, n) FROM UNNEST(['']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS INT64)]) p CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-1]) n
=> null

SELECT SUBSTR(s, 1, n) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS INT64)]) n
=> null

SELECT SUBSTRING(s, 1, n) FROM UNNEST(['']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-1]) n
=> error: Third argument in SUBSTR() cannot be negative

SELECT SAFE.SUBSTR(s, 1, n) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-1]) n
=> null

SELECT SAFE.SUBSTRING(s, 1, n) FROM UNNEST(['aあ😀']) s CROSS JOIN UNNEST([-1]) n
=> null
